command:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED_LIVE=18770d8e333af1bc49a818da4dbd5c2e482b859e0142d0213df6c956184c931e
EXPECTED_WORKER=8f291c5482f9b70f33a146e4456a8c5cd6262a19
VISUAL=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
BRIDGE=$HOME/.claude/star/local_bridge_state/repo
PRE=$(sha256sum "$VISUAL/buehne.html"|awk '{print $1}')
test "$PRE" = "$EXPECTED_LIVE" || { echo LIVE_SUBJECT_DRIFT=$PRE; exit 41; }
git -C "$BRIDGE" fetch -q origin refs/heads/chatgpt-gpt56sol-avatar-body-visible-production-ab-20260912:refs/remotes/origin/chatgpt-gpt56sol-avatar-body-visible-production-ab-20260912
GOT=$(git -C "$BRIDGE" rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/chatgpt-gpt56sol-avatar-body-visible-production-ab-20260912)
test "$GOT" = "$EXPECTED_WORKER" || { echo WORKER_SUBJECT_DRIFT=$GOT; exit 42; }
TD=$(mktemp -d /tmp/go-avatar-body-visible-confirm-XXXXXX)
git -C "$BRIDGE" show "$GOT:handoff/avatar-body-shoulder-microkinematics-20260912/body_fullscene_shadow_ab.py" > "$TD/body_fullscene_shadow_ab.py"
git -C "$BRIDGE" show "$GOT:handoff/avatar-body-shoulder-microkinematics-20260912/body_fullscene_visible_shadow_ab_v2.py" > "$TD/body_fullscene_visible_shadow_ab_v2.py"
echo HOST=$(hostname) USER=$(whoami) DISPLAY=:0 WORKER_SHA=$GOT LIVE_PRE_SHA=$PRE TEMP_SUBJECT=$TD
for REP in 1 2; do GO_AVATAR_DISPLAY=:0 python3 "$TD/body_fullscene_visible_shadow_ab_v2.py" --visual-root "$VISUAL" --chrome /opt/google/chrome/chrome --duration 12 | tee "$TD/rep${REP}.log"; done
python3 - "$TD" <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, sys
td=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); rows=[]
for rep in (1,2):
    lines=(td/f'rep{rep}.log').read_text().splitlines(); objs=[]
    for line in lines:
        line=line.strip()
        if line.startswith('{'):
            try: objs.append(json.loads(line))
            except json.JSONDecodeError: pass
    if not objs: raise SystemExit(f'EVIDENCE_INVALID rep{rep}: no JSON report')
    r=objs[-1]; b=r['runs']['base']['summary']; s=r['runs']['shadow']['summary']; m=r['runs']['shadow'].get('meta') or {}
    checks={
      'base_samples_ge8': b.get('samples',0)>=8,
      'shadow_samples_ge8': s.get('samples',0)>=8,
      'renderer_amd': 'AMD' in str(m.get('renderer','')),
      'shadow_mean_ge58': float(s.get('fps_mean') or 0)>=58.0,
      'mean_delta_ge_minus1': float(s.get('fps_mean') or 0)-float(b.get('fps_mean') or 0)>=-1.0,
      'min_delta_ge_minus2': float(s.get('fps_min') or 0)-float(b.get('fps_min') or 0)>=-2.0,
      'shadow_draws_material': int(s.get('last_shadow_draws') or 0)>30,
      'live_mutation_false': r.get('live_mutation') is False,
    }
    row={'rep':rep,'base':b,'shadow':s,'renderer':m.get('renderer'),'checks':checks}; rows.append(row); print('CONFIRM_REP',json.dumps(row,sort_keys=True))
    bad=[k for k,v in checks.items() if not v]
    if bad: raise SystemExit(f'CONFIRMATORY_GATE_FAIL rep{rep}: {bad}')
print('CONFIRMATORY_NUMERIC_GATE=PASS')
PY
POST=$(sha256sum "$VISUAL/buehne.html"|awk '{print $1}')
test "$POST" = "$PRE" || { echo LIVE_MUTATION_DETECTED=$POST; exit 43; }
if ps -eo args | grep -E '[c]hrome.*body-fullscene-visible-chrome-' >/dev/null; then echo SCRATCH_CHROME_LEAK=1; ps -eo pid,ppid,args | grep -E '[c]hrome.*body-fullscene-visible-chrome-' || true; exit 44; fi
echo LIVE_POST_SHA=$POST
echo BODY_VISIBLE_CONFIRMATORY_V2=PASS
